title: Foreign Workers Law, 5751-1991
source_id: ס"ח תשנ"א, 112 (Sefer HaChukim 5751, p 112); Knesset IsraelLawID 2001138; Wikisource page 'חוק עובדים זרים'
verified_how: Knesset Open Data KNS_IsraelLaw record fetched 23 September 2026: IsraelLawID 2001138, Name 'חוק עובדים זרים, התשנ"א-1991', KnessetNum 12, PublicationDate 1991-03-21, LatestPublicationDate 2024-02-21, LawValidityDesc 'תקף', ValidityFinishDate null, LastUpdatedDate 2025-09-15. KNS_LawBinding returned 43 rows: 1 'החוק המקורי' with PageNumber '112' and 42 'מתקן' rows. The official KNS_IsraelLawName table for this IsraelLawID returned three successive titles, confirming that the Act has been RENAMED twice: 'חוק עובדים זרים (העסקה שלא כדין), התשנ"א-1991' (original), then 'חוק עובדים זרים (איסור העסקה שלא כדין והבטחת תנאים הוגנים), התשנ"א-1991', and now the current short form 'חוק עובדים זרים, התשנ"א-1991'. The Hebrew Wikisource page prints 'חוק עובדים זרים, התשנ"א–1991', citation 'ס"ח תשנ"א, 112' with amendments through 'תשפ"ד, 548', and no repeal marker; the official page 112 and the תשפ"ד/2024 last amendment both match (LatestPublicationDate 2024-02-21).
notes: The employer-side statute: it makes it an offence to employ a foreign worker without a permit and without a valid visa/residence permit, imposes the employer's duties (written contract in a language the worker understands, medical insurance, suitable accommodation, wage statements), creates the permit and levy regime and the enforcement/administrative-fine machinery. Renamed twice (see verified_how) - a citation to 'חוק עובדים זרים (העסקה שלא כדין)' in older material is the SAME Act, so do not treat it as a separate or repealed instrument. Pairs with the Entry into Israel Law below: this Act governs the employer and the employment relationship, the Entry Law governs the worker's visa.
